ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a radical/alkoxy component with a negatively charged oxygen: the upper O⁻ is connected to the central carbon, the central carbon is also connected to an R group and OEt, and there is a radical dot next to the central carbon; on the right side is an H–OEt component. There are also curved arrows in the figure, but the question requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: Split and count according to the specified method, and exclude all bonds involving hydrogen. The non-hydrogen bonds on the left include O⁻–C, C–R, central C–O, internal O–C of OEt, and internal C–C of OEt, for a total of 5. method.method_draft: First inspect the image and split it into the left radical/alkoxide component and the right H–OEt component. On the left, count non-H bonds: O⁻–C, C–R, C–O, plus the OEt internal O–C and C–C bonds, giving 5. On the right, ignore the H–O bond because it involves hydrogen, but count the OEt internal O–C and C–C bonds, giving 2. Add 5 + 2 to obtain 7.
